title: Setup: Register SSO/SAML Provider actions show on plans without the external IdP (no 'mounted' flag in auth config features)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found by the cloud os-dev agent on objectstack-ai/cloud#4320 (PR #4524), out-of-scope finding class b. The reading was taken at cloud's framework pin 181ad7d4, and the same code is on objectstack main 0e9ff949cb4.

## What happens

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts` gives the `register_sso_provider` and `register_saml_provider` actions `visible = 'current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true'`, and nothing else.
- The console reads its predicate `features` from `/api/v1/auth/config` (ui app-shell `AppContent.tsx`). Its `sso` key has been refined to mean "usable", i.e. at least one provider exists. No key says whether `@better-auth/sso` is mounted.
- So on a plan without the external IdP (a hosted Free or Team plan, or after a downgrade), an admin sees both Register buttons. Submitting answers 403 `PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`.

## Expected

The auth config serves a "mounted" flag from `isSsoWired`, declared in spec `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema`. The two register actions and the empty-state copy are gated on it, so a plan that cannot register a provider does not offer to.

Seam: `spec:AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` → renderer: the `sys_sso_provider` list toolbar actions. Cloud has no key to set short of a workaround, so the fix belongs on the platform.

Carrier: objectstack. Triage sets the lane and level.
